verdict.rationale: A probe indicates an official OCI MCP server repository exists (github.com/oracle/mcp), which would let an AI agent connect via MCP, but there is no first-party documentation, setup guide, or independent confirmation detailing its capabilities or maturity — other probes for docs/OpenAPI endpoints came back 404. Missing for 10: official Oracle docs describing the MCP server's tools/setup, independent hands-on verification, and details on scope/maturity of the integration.
